fixture_kind: synthetic records shaped by pinned upstream public JSON
compatibility_assertions: Public project JSON is an object with integer id; index JSON is an array of records.
Baseline status and justification keys use display aliases.
Blank justification values are omitted by the pinned JSON builder; absence is retained in progress.
Project-entry attribution/license and upstream percentage fields are preserved without local inference.
URL search can match URL spellings more broadly than exact identity comparison; retain all candidates.
Controller set_valid_query_url reconstructs query parameters using Addressable; transport canonicalizes parameter ordering and encoding while preserving query values.
pagination: Synthetic Link headers exercise optional authoritative metadata. Pinned array bodies alone establish neither totals nor the existence of another nonempty page.
privacy: All names, IDs, URLs and answer text are synthetic; no user/project data was fetched.

canonical_query.rule: Sort parameter names lexically; percent-encode UTF-8 bytes except RFC 3986 unreserved characters. Encode space as %20 and literal plus as %2B. Preserve decoded query values exactly.

json_route_canonicalization.api_documentation: docs/api.md lines 34, 47, 534-538 show unprefixed JSON examples and explain the JSON locale-redirection exemption.
json_route_canonicalization.routes: config/routes.rb lines 90-97 define the locale-independent single-project JSON route; lines 129-133 permanently redirect localized single-project JSON URLs to it.
json_route_canonicalization.controller: app/controllers/application_controller.rb lines 399-401 and 587-592 exempt json/csv formats from missing-locale redirects.
json_route_canonicalization.scope: The /en advice in docs/api.md lines 172-173 belongs to as=badge navigation, not ordinary public JSON reads. HTML edit URLs remain English-prefixed.
json_route_canonicalization.redirect_policy: Construct canonical fixed paths directly; reject rather than follow any unexpected redirects.
